title: Thoughts I Cannot Say Out Loud

current_concerns.primary_problems: Since giving birth, unwanted and distressing images of the baby being harmed come into my mind. I find them frightening and strongly reject them. They are more noticeable at home while caring for the baby, so I try not to bathe the baby alone and repeatedly check on her several times at night.
current_concerns.goals: I want these thoughts to stop and want to feel safer when caring for my daughter alone.
